title: A Second-Hand Discovery
sentences: I've never been someone who enjoys spending money on expensive new things.
Last month, though, I decided I needed a proper winter coat that would actually last.
Instead of buying something brand new, I went to a second-hand shop near my house.
While I was looking through the racks, I found a beautiful coat that fit perfectly.
It was clearly expensive when it was new, but the price was surprisingly low.
I almost didn't buy it because there was a small tear near the pocket.
The shop assistant kindly offered to fix it for me before I paid.
Since I picked it up, I've worn that coat almost every single day.
Now I always check second-hand shops first before buying anything new.
It saves money, and it feels better for the planet as well.
